import pytest
from bank_account import BankAccount

# Happy path tests
def test_initialization_default_balance():
    acc = BankAccount(owner="Alice")
    assert acc.owner == "Alice"
    assert acc.balance == 0.0

def test_initialization_with_positive_balance():
    acc = BankAccount(owner="Bob", balance=100.5)
    assert acc.owner == "Bob"
    assert acc.balance == 100.5

def test_deposit_increases_balance():
    acc = BankAccount(owner="Carol", balance=50.0)
    new_balance = acc.deposit(25.0)
    assert new_balance == 75.0
    assert acc.balance == 75.0

def test_multiple_deposits_accumulate():
    acc = BankAccount(owner="Dave")
    acc.deposit(10.0)
    acc.deposit(15.5)
    assert acc.balance == 25.5

def test_withdraw_decreases_balance():
    acc = BankAccount(owner="Eve", balance=200.0)
    new_balance = acc.withdraw(80.0)
    assert new_balance == 120.0
    assert acc.balance == 120.0

def test_multiple_withdrawals_accumulate():
    acc = BankAccount(owner="Frank", balance=100.0)
    acc.withdraw(30.0)
    acc.withdraw(20.0)
    assert acc.balance == 50.0

# Boundary and invalid input tests
@pytest.mark.parametrize("initial_balance", [-0.01, -100])
def test_initialization_negative_balance_raises(initial_balance):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Initial balance cannot be negative"):
        BankAccount(owner="Grace", balance=initial_balance)

@pytest.mark.parametrize("deposit_amount", [0, -0.01, -10])
def test_deposit_invalid_amount_raises(deposit_amount):
    acc = BankAccount(owner="Heidi", balance=10.0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Deposit amount must be positive"):
        acc.deposit(deposit_amount)

@pytest.mark.parametrize("withdraw_amount", [0, -0.01, -5])
def test_withdraw_invalid_amount_raises(withdraw_amount):
    acc = BankAccount(owner="Ivan", balance=20.0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Withdrawal amount must be positive"):
        acc.withdraw(withdraw_amount)

def test_withdraw_insufficient_funds_raises():
    acc = BankAccount(owner="Judy", balance=30.0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Insufficient funds"):
        acc.withdraw(31.0)

def test_deposit_and_withdraw_edge_cases():
    acc = BankAccount(owner="Ken", balance=0.0)
    # Deposit a very small positive amount
    acc.deposit(1e-9)
    assert acc.balance == pytest.approx(1e-9)

    # Withdraw the exact amount
    acc.withdraw(1e-9)
    assert acc.balance == pytest.approx(0.0)

def test_float_precision_handling():
    acc = BankAccount(owner="Liam", balance=0.1)
    acc.deposit(0.2)
    # Due to floating point representation, use approx
    assert acc.balance == pytest.approx(0.3)
    acc.withdraw(0.1)
    assert acc.balance == pytest.approx(0.2)
